_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
PID reports now retain actual integral and derivative values from both GUI and bench recording schemas. Actuator reversal scoring accumulates travel from each extremum so smooth, small steps cannot hide a real direction change. The unchanged 0.25-percentage-point deadband and 0.5/s gate remain visible.

The bench procedure scores the full startup before PID ramp rebasing. Firmware and controller settings remain unchanged (Default292 / Valinor42). Experimental293 was rejected after its measured deflation startup delay; it is not included.

Includes the prior Simulator layout, recording recovery, native logging, multi-protocol queue and physical-unit plotting improvements. Calibration profiles and original recordings remain preserved.
